name: Four-banded Stink Bug Wasp
desc: Four-banded Stink Bug Wasp (Bicyrtes quadrifasciatus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bicyrtes quadrifasciatus, the four-banded stink bug hunter wasp, is a species of sand wasp in the family Bembicidae. It is found in North America.
